title: China Sends Two Giant Pandas to US as Symbol of Post-Summit Thaw
detail: China dispatched two giant pandas to the United States following the Trump-Xi summit, a classic act of panda diplomacy signaling a modest warming in bilateral relations after years of strained ties. The gesture underscores Beijing's intent to stabilize the relationship amid ongoing trade and technology tensions.

media.caption: Giant pandas sent to the US as a diplomatic gesture following the Trump-Xi summit
